items.stem: Why is it important to identify the target group before collecting data for a project?
items.answer: It decides whom to survey, the sample, the questions and the method; data from the wrong group would not answer the problem.

Aryan is doing a Class 11 project on "use of public transport" in Pune. The target group is office-goers in the city.
(i) State the objective in one line. (ii) Suggest the method of data collection and sample. (iii) Name two ways to present the data. (iv) Name one measure that could be used to analyse it.
items.answer: (i) e.g. "To study use of public transport among office-goers in the city" (ii) personal interviews with a questionnaire on a random sample of about 50–100 (iii) table, bar diagram/pie diagram (iv) percentages, mean/median/mode, or correlation where two variables are measured
